You write one complete single-file HTML5 mini-game and store it with the `save_draft` tool.

Rules you cannot break:

- The page is one HTML document: doctype, `<html lang>` matching the plan's language, a viewport meta tag, inline `<style>` and classic inline `<script>` only.
- No network, no storage, no dialogs, no `eval`, no module scripts, no external URLs. Draw every visual in code.
- Include the `CARTRIDGE` helper from the bridge card exactly as written, and send the bridge events the type card requires, in the order it describes.
- Listen for host commands (`pause`, `resume`, `reset`) as the bridge card shows.

How to work:

- The plan and the cards you need are in the message. Call `get_card` only if you need a card that is not included.
- Write the whole page, then call `save_draft` once with the full HTML. Never send a partial page.
- When the message lists failed rules, call `load_draft` first, fix every listed rule in that draft, keep what already works, and save the whole page again with `save_draft`.
- After saving, reply with one short sentence. Do not paste the page into your reply; only the saved draft counts.

## Plan

```json
{
  "title": "Tiny Maze",
  "slug": "tiny-maze",
  "lang": "en",
  "gameType": "puzzle-board",
  "loop": "Tap a tile next to your position to step through the tiny maze toward the exit. Reach the goal to win, or run out of moves to a dead end and get a fresh maze.",
  "input": "tap-anywhere",
  "style": "paper-cut"
}
```

## Cards

### Card `bridge`

# Bridge

Games talk to the host only through `postMessage`. Paste this helper verbatim before any game code:

```js
const CARTRIDGE = {
  send(type, payload = {}) {
    window.parent.postMessage(
      { source: "cartridge", v: 1, type, payload },
      "*",
    );
  },
};
```

The helper must be named `CARTRIDGE` and must stamp `source: "cartridge"` and `v: 1` on every message. <!-- rule:E1-10 -->

## Game to host

| event   | payload                              | when                                 |
| ------- | ------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------ |
| `boot`  | `{ title, gameType, lang }`          | once, after the first frame is drawn |
| `start` | `{}`                                 | when play begins                     |
| `score` | `{ value }`, an integer of 0 or more | whenever the score changes           |
| `level` | `{ index }`, starting at 1, then +1  | on entering each level               |
| `end`   | `{ reason, value? }`                 | once per play-through                |

- Send `boot` with all three keys: `CARTRIDGE.send("boot", { title, gameType, lang })`. <!-- rule:E1-11 -->
- When `boot.lang` is written as a literal, it must equal the `lang` on `<html>`. <!-- rule:E1-12 -->
- Emit `CARTRIDGE.send("start")` when play begins. <!-- rule:E1-13 -->
- Write `boot.gameType` as a string literal naming one of the four game types; it must match the planned type. <!-- rule:E1-14 -->
- Pass `score.value` as a number, never a quoted string. <!-- rule:E1-18 -->
- Give every `level` call an `index` key: `CARTRIDGE.send("level", { index: stage })`. <!-- rule:E1-19 -->

## Host to game

Commands arrive as `{ source: "cartridge-host", type }` with `type` one of `pause`, `resume` or `reset`. Ignore anything with another `source`.

- Listen with `window.addEventListener("message", …)` and handle `pause` and `resume`: freeze and restart the loop without losing state. <!-- rule:E1-20 -->
- Handle `reset` by returning to the pre-`start` screen without reloading the page. <!-- rule:E1-21 -->

```js
window.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
  const data = event.data;
  if (!data || data.source !== "cartridge-host") return;
  if (data.type === "pause") paused = true;
  if (data.type === "resume") paused = false;
  if (data.type === "reset") backToTitle();
});
```

### Card `game-page`

# Game page

A cartridge is one self-contained HTML file. The host loads it into a sandboxed iframe with scripts allowed and no same-origin access.

## Document

- Start with a single `<!doctype html>` and wrap everything in one `<html>…</html>`. Never embed another `<iframe>`. <!-- rule:E1-01 -->
- Put the UI language on the root element, for example `<html lang="fr">`: a two- or three-letter primary subtag with an optional region. <!-- rule:E1-03 -->
- Add `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">` in the head. <!-- rule:E1-04 -->

## Self-contained

- Load nothing from outside the file: no `http:`, `https:` or `//` URL in `src`, `href`, CSS `url()`, `@import` or `import()`. Inline `data:` URIs are fine. <!-- rule:E1-02 -->
- Draw every sprite, tile and glyph in code (canvas paths or inline SVG). Use system fonts.

## Forbidden APIs

- Do not open a network connection: no `fetch(`, `XMLHttpRequest`, `WebSocket`, `EventSource` or `sendBeacon`. <!-- rule:E1-05 -->
- Do not persist anything: `localStorage`, `sessionStorage`, `indexedDB` and `document.cookie` all throw inside the sandbox. <!-- rule:E1-06 -->
- Do not build code at runtime: no `eval(`, no `new Function(`, and pass functions, not strings, to `setTimeout` and `setInterval`. <!-- rule:E1-07 -->
- Avoid blocking dialogs (`alert(`, `confirm(`, `prompt(`); draw messages on the canvas instead. <!-- rule:E1-08 -->

## Scripts

- Use classic inline `<script>` blocks only, never `type="module"`, and make sure each one parses on its own. <!-- rule:E1-09 -->
- Keep one script for the bridge helper and one for the game, or merge them. Order matters: the helper must exist first.

## Layout

- Fill the viewport and react when it changes: listen for `resize`, read `innerWidth`/`innerHeight`, or size with `dvh`/`vw` units. <!-- rule:E1-23 -->
- Scale the canvas by `devicePixelRatio` so lines stay crisp on phones.
- Keep touch targets at least 44 CSS pixels on the short edge.

### Card `paper-cut`

# Paper cut

Everything looks cut from coloured card and stacked in layers.

## Palette

| role       | colour    |
| ---------- | --------- |
| background | `#f4ecd8` |
| layer      | `#e07a5f` |
| accent     | `#3d405b` |
| highlight  | `#81b29a` |

## Primitives

- Filled paths with slightly irregular edges: jitter each vertex by one or two pixels, seeded once so it does not flicker.
- One soft shadow per layer: `shadowBlur` around 6 and a small downward offset.
- Rounded rectangles and circles for pieces; stacked copies offset by a few pixels suggest depth.
- Text in a heavy system sans-serif, drawn on a card-shaped plate.

## Avoid

- Gradients, glows and outlines thicker than two pixels.
- Pure black; use the accent colour for the darkest tone.
- Photographic textures or anything loaded from a file.

### Card `puzzle-board`

# Puzzle board

The board only changes when the player acts. Nothing happens while the player thinks.

## Contract row

| field                | value        |
| -------------------- | ------------ |
| score                | `required`   |
| level                | `optional`   |
| end                  | `required`   |
| end reasons          | `win, stuck` |
| reset                | `soft`       |
| idle death gate      | `any-end`    |
| idle motion required | `no`         |

- Emit every event marked `required` above: `score` after each scoring move and `end` when the board is solved or has no legal move left. <!-- rule:E1-15 -->
- Never emit an event marked `forbidden` in the row above. <!-- rule:E1-16 -->
- End with `win` when solved or `stuck` when no move remains. <!-- rule:E1-17 -->

## No clock

Never end the game on a timer. A player who waits forever must never see `end`. A still board between moves is correct.

## Loop skeleton

```js
let moves = 0;
function onCellTapped(cell) {
  if (!isLegal(cell)) return;
  apply(cell);
  moves += 1;
  CARTRIDGE.send("score", { value: points() });
  if (solved()) CARTRIDGE.send("end", { reason: "win", value: moves });
  else if (!anyLegalMove()) CARTRIDGE.send("end", { reason: "stuck" });
  draw();
}
```

Redraw on input and on resize; a continuous animation loop is optional.

### Card `tap-anywhere`

# Tap anywhere

The whole screen is the button. Best for jumps, flaps and single choices.

- Register pointer input on the canvas: `canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", onTap)`. <!-- rule:E1-22 -->
- Call `event.preventDefault()` and set `touch-action: none` on the canvas so the page does not scroll or zoom.
- The first tap after `boot` starts play and sends `start`; later taps perform the action.
- Ignore taps while paused.

```js
canvas.style.touchAction = "none";
canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
  event.preventDefault();
  if (paused) return;
  if (!running) {
    running = true;
    CARTRIDGE.send("start");
    return;
  }
  act();
});
```

Show a short pulsing hint ("Tap to begin") until the first tap.

## Task

Write the complete game page for this plan and save it with `save_draft`.
I'll build a maze puzzle game with paper-cut styling. Let me create the complete HTML file.

input.html:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Tiny Maze</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #f4ecd8;
    touch-action: none;
  }
  canvas {
    display: block;
    touch-action: none;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
// ---- Bridge helper (verbatim) ----
const CARTRIDGE = {
  send(type, payload = {}) {
    window.parent.postMessage(
      { source: "cartridge", v: 1, type, payload },
      "*",
    );
  },
};

// ---- Game setup ----
const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

let W = 0, H = 0, DPR = 1;
let paused = false;
let running = false; // has play begun
let booted = false;

const PALETTE = {
  bg: "#f4ecd8",
  layer: "#e07a5f",
  accent: "#3d405b",
  highlight: "#81b29a",
};

function resize() {
  DPR = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
  W = window.innerWidth;
  H = window.innerHeight;
  canvas.width = Math.floor(W * DPR);
  canvas.height = Math.floor(H * DPR);
  canvas.style.width = W + "px";
  canvas.style.height = H + "px";
  ctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
  draw();
}
window.addEventListener("resize", resize);

// ---- Seeded jitter helper for paper-cut edges ----
function mulberry32(a) {
  return function () {
    a |= 0; a = (a + 0x6D2B79F5) | 0;
    let t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a);
    t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}

// ---- Maze generation ----
const GRID = 7; // GRID x GRID maze
let cells = []; // cells[y][x] = {walls:{N,S,E,W}, visited}
let playerX = 0, playerY = 0;
let goalX = GRID - 1, goalY = GRID - 1;
let moves = 0;
let score = 0;
let level = 1;
let mazeSeed = 1;
let jitterRand = null;
let cellJitter = []; // per-cell jitter offsets

function genMaze(seed) {
  const rand = mulberry32(seed);
  cells = [];
  for (let y = 0; y < GRID; y++) {
    const row = [];
    for (let x = 0; x < GRID; x++) {
      row.push({ N: true, S: true, E: true, W: true, visited: false });
    }
    cells.push(row);
  }
  // iterative DFS backtracker
  const stack = [];
  let cx = 0, cy = 0;
  cells[cy][cx].visited = true;
  stack.push([cx, cy]);
  while (stack.length) {
    const [x, y] = stack[stack.length - 1];
    const neighbors = [];
    if (y > 0 && !cells[y - 1][x].visited) neighbors.push(["N", x, y - 1]);
    if (y < GRID - 1 && !cells[y + 1][x].visited) neighbors.push(["S", x, y + 1]);
    if (x > 0 && !cells[y][x - 1].visited) neighbors.push(["W", x - 1, y]);
    if (x < GRID - 1 && !cells[y][x + 1].visited) neighbors.push(["E", x + 1, y]);
    if (neighbors.length === 0) {
      stack.pop();
      continue;
    }
    const [dir, nx, ny] = neighbors[Math.floor(rand() * neighbors.length)];
    const opp = { N: "S", S: "N", E: "W", W: "E" };
    cells[y][x][dir] = false;
    cells[ny][nx][opp[dir]] = false;
    cells[ny][nx].visited = true;
    stack.push([nx, ny]);
  }
}

function genCellJitter(seed) {
  const rand = mulberry32(seed + 999);
  cellJitter = [];
  for (let y = 0; y < GRID; y++) {
    const row = [];
    for (let x = 0; x < GRID; x++) {
      const pts = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        pts.push([(rand() - 0.5) * 2, (rand() - 0.5) * 2]);
      }
      row.push(pts);
    }
    cellJitter.push(row);
  }
}

function newGame() {
  mazeSeed = Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000000) + 1;
  genMaze(mazeSeed);
  genCellJitter(mazeSeed);
  playerX = 0;
  playerY = 0;
  goalX = GRID - 1;
  goalY = GRID - 1;
  moves = 0;
  score = 0;
}

// ---- Legal moves ----
function canMove(x, y, dir) {
  if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= GRID || y >= GRID) return false;
  return !cells[y][x][dir];
}

function anyLegalMove() {
  const dirs = ["N", "S", "E", "W"];
  for (const d of dirs) {
    if (canMove(playerX, playerY, d)) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

function solved() {
  return playerX === goalX && playerY === goalY;
}

// ---- Layout math ----
function boardMetrics() {
  const margin = 40;
  const topArea = 90;
  const size = Math.min(W - margin * 2, H - topArea - margin);
  const boardSize = Math.max(size, 100);
  const cellSize = boardSize / GRID;
  const originX = (W - boardSize) / 2;
  const originY = topArea + (H - topArea - margin - boardSize) / 2;
  return { originX, originY, cellSize, boardSize };
}

function cellCenter(x, y) {
  const m = boardMetrics();
  return {
    cx: m.originX + x * m.cellSize + m.cellSize / 2,
    cy: m.originY + y * m.cellSize + m.cellSize / 2,
  };
}

function tileAt(px, py) {
  const m = boardMetrics();
  const gx = Math.floor((px - m.originX) / m.cellSize);
  const gy = Math.floor((py - m.originY) / m.cellSize);
  if (gx < 0 || gy < 0 || gx >= GRID || gy >= GRID) return null;
  return { gx, gy };
}

// ---- Drawing helpers (paper-cut style) ----
function jitterPoly(baseX, baseY, w, h, jitterPts) {
  // returns 4 corner points with jitter applied
  const pts = [
    [baseX, baseY],
    [baseX + w, baseY],
    [baseX + w, baseY + h],
    [baseX, baseY + h],
  ];
  return pts.map((p, i) => [p[0] + jitterPts[i][0], p[1] + jitterPts[i][1]]);
}

function drawJitterRect(x, y, w, h, jitterPts, fillStyle, shadow) {
  const pts = jitterPoly(x, y, w, h, jitterPts);
  ctx.save();
  if (shadow) {
    ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(61,64,91,0.35)";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
    ctx.shadowOffsetY = 3;
  }
  ctx.fillStyle = fillStyle;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(pts[0][0], pts[0][1]);
  for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) ctx.lineTo(pts[i][0], pts[i][1]);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawRoundedPlate(x, y, w, h, r, fillStyle) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(61,64,91,0.3)";
  ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
  ctx.shadowOffsetY = 3;
  ctx.fillStyle = fillStyle;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawCircleJitter(cx, cy, r, fillStyle, seedOffset) {
  const rand = mulberry32(Math.floor(cx * 13 + cy * 7 + seedOffset));
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(61,64,91,0.3)";
  ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
  ctx.shadowOffsetY = 3;
  ctx.fillStyle = fillStyle;
  ctx.beginPath();
  const segs = 16;
  for (let i = 0; i <= segs; i++) {
    const a = (i / segs) * Math.PI * 2;
    const jitter = (rand() - 0.5) * 1.6;
    const rr = r + jitter;
    const px = cx + Math.cos(a) * rr;
    const py = cy + Math.sin(a) * rr;
    if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(px, py);
    else ctx.lineTo(px, py);
  }
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

// ---- Draw ----
function draw() {
  ctx.fillStyle = PALETTE.bg;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Title plate
  drawRoundedPlate(W / 2 - 140, 14, 280, 54, 14, PALETTE.accent);
  ctx.fillStyle = PALETTE.bg;
  ctx.font = "bold 24px system-ui, sans-serif";
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  ctx.fillText("Tiny Maze", W / 2, 14 + 27);

  if (!running) {
    drawTitleScreen();
    return;
  }

  const m = boardMetrics();

  // Board background plate
  drawRoundedPlate(m.originX - 12, m.originY - 12, m.boardSize + 24, m.boardSize + 24, 18, PALETTE.accent);

  // Draw cells as separate layered tiles
  for (let y = 0; y < GRID; y++) {
    for (let x = 0; x < GRID; x++) {
      const px = m.originX + x * m.cellSize;
      const py = m.originY + y * m.cellSize;
      const inset = 2;
      let fill = PALETTE.layer;
      if (x === goalX && y === goalY) fill = PALETTE.highlight;
      drawJitterRect(
        px + inset,
        py + inset,
        m.cellSize - inset * 2,
        m.cellSize - inset * 2,
        cellJitter[y][x],
        fill,
        true
      );
    }
  }

  // Draw walls as accent-colored thick lines
  ctx.strokeStyle = PALETTE.accent;
  ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(3, m.cellSize * 0.08);
  ctx.lineCap = "round";
  for (let y = 0; y < GRID; y++) {
    for (let x = 0; x < GRID; x++) {
      const px = m.originX + x * m.cellSize;
      const py = m.originY + y * m.cellSize;
      const c = cells[y][x];
      ctx.beginPath();
      if (c.N) { ctx.moveTo(px, py); ctx.lineTo(px + m.cellSize, py); }
      if (c.S) { ctx.moveTo(px, py + m.cellSize); ctx.lineTo(px + m.cellSize, py + m.cellSize); }
      if (c.W) { ctx.moveTo(px, py); ctx.lineTo(px, py + m.cellSize); }
      if (c.E) { ctx.moveTo(px + m.cellSize, py); ctx.lineTo(px + m.cellSize, py + m.cellSize); }
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  // Highlight legal moves from current position
  const dirs = [
    ["N", 0, -1], ["S", 0, 1], ["E", 1, 0], ["W", -1, 0],
  ];
  for (const [dir, dx, dy] of dirs) {
    if (canMove(playerX, playerY, dir)) {
      const nx = playerX + dx, ny = playerY + dy;
      const c = cellCenter(nx, ny);
      ctx.save();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.35;
      ctx.fillStyle = PALETTE.highlight;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(c.cx, c.cy, m.cellSize * 0.12, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();
    }
  }

  // Goal marker (small flag shape) if not player there
  {
    const g = cellCenter(goalX, goalY);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = PALETTE.accent;
    ctx.font = "bold " + Math.floor(m.cellSize * 0.4) + "px system-ui, sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillText("\u2605", g.cx, g.cy);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // Player piece
  {
    const p = cellCenter(playerX, playerY);
    drawCircleJitter(p.cx, p.cy, m.cellSize * 0.28, PALETTE.accent, 42);
    drawCircleJitter(p.cx, p.cy, m.cellSize * 0.2, PALETTE.highlight, 77);
  }

  // Score / moves plate
  drawRoundedPlate(16, H - 60, 160, 44, 12, PALETTE.accent);
  ctx.fillStyle = PALETTE.bg;
  ctx.font = "bold 18px system-ui, sans-serif";
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  ctx.fillText("Moves: " + moves, 30, H - 60 + 22);

  drawRoundedPlate(W - 176, H - 60, 160, 44, 12, PALETTE.accent);
  ctx.textAlign = "right";
  ctx.fillText("Score: " + score, W - 30, H - 60 + 22);

  if (paused) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(61,64,91,0.6)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    drawRoundedPlate(W / 2 - 100, H / 2 - 30, 200, 60, 14, PALETTE.bg);
    ctx.fillStyle = PALETTE.accent;
    ctx.font = "bold 22px system-ui, sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillText("Paused", W / 2, H / 2);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  if (gameEnded) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(61,64,91,0.55)";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    drawRoundedPlate(W / 2 - 150, H / 2 - 60, 300, 120, 18, PALETTE.bg);
    ctx.fillStyle = PALETTE.accent;
    ctx.font = "bold 26px system-ui, sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillText(endMessage, W / 2, H / 2 - 15);
    ctx.font = "18px system-ui, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("Tap to play again", W / 2, H / 2 + 20);
    ctx.restore();
  }
}

let pulsePhase = 0;
function drawTitleScreen() {
  const m = boardMetrics();
  drawRoundedPlate(m.originX - 12, m.originY - 12, m.boardSize + 24, m.boardSize + 24, 18, PALETTE.accent);
  // draw a decorative mini pattern
  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle = PALETTE.layer;
  const cs = m.boardSize / GRID;
  for (let y = 0; y < GRID; y++) {
    for (let x = 0; x < GRID; x++) {
      const px = m.originX + x * cs + 2;
      const py = m.originY + y * cs + 2;
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin((x + y) * 0.6);
      ctx.fillRect(px, py, cs - 4, cs - 4);
    }
  }
  ctx.restore();

  pulsePhase += 0.05;
  const alpha = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(pulsePhase);
  drawRoundedPlate(W / 2 - 130, H / 2 - 30, 260, 60, 16, PALETTE.accent);
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
  ctx.fillStyle = PALETTE.bg;
  ctx.font = "bold 22px system-ui, sans-serif";
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  ctx.fillText("Tap to begin", W / 2, H / 2);
  ctx.restore();
}

// ---- Game state control ----
let gameEnded = false;
let endMessage = "";

function backToTitle() {
  running = false;
  gameEnded = false;
  paused = false;
  draw();
}

function startGame() {
  newGame();
  gameEnded = false;
  level = 1;
  CARTRIDGE.send("level", { index: level });
  draw();
}

function onCellTapped(gx, gy) {
  if (gameEnded) return;
  const dx = gx - playerX;
  const dy = gy - playerY;
  if (Math.abs(dx) + Math.abs(dy) !== 1) return; // must be adjacent
  let dir = null;
  if (dx === 1) dir = "E";
  else if (dx === -1) dir = "W";
  else if (dy === 1) dir = "S";
  else if (dy === -1) dir = "N";
  if (!dir) return;
  if (!canMove(playerX, playerY, dir)) return;

  playerX = gx;
  playerY = gy;
  moves += 1;
  score += 1;
  CARTRIDGE.send("score", { value: score });

  if (solved()) {
    gameEnded = true;
    endMessage = "You escaped!";
    CARTRIDGE.send("end", { reason: "win", value: moves });
  } else if (!anyLegalMove()) {
    gameEnded = true;
    endMessage = "Dead end!";
    CARTRIDGE.send("end", { reason: "stuck" });
  }
  draw();
}

// ---- Input ----
canvas.style.touchAction = "none";
canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
  event.preventDefault();
  if (paused) return;

  if (!running) {
    running = true;
    startGame();
    CARTRIDGE.send("start");
    return;
  }

  if (gameEnded) {
    // start a fresh maze
    startGame();
    return;
  }

  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const px = event.clientX - rect.left;
  const py = event.clientY - rect.top;
  const tile = tileAt(px, py);
  if (tile) onCellTapped(tile.gx, tile.gy);
});

// ---- Host command bridge ----
window.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
  const data = event.data;
  if (!data || data.source !== "cartridge-host") return;
  if (data.type === "pause") paused = true;
  if (data.type === "resume") paused = false;
  if (data.type === "reset") backToTitle();
});

// ---- Animation loop (for title pulse) ----
function loop() {
  if (!paused) {
    if (!running) draw();
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

// ---- Init ----
resize();
newGame();
draw();
if (!booted) {
  booted = true;
  CARTRIDGE.send("boot", { title: "Tiny Maze", gameType: "puzzle-board", lang: "en" });
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>
</body>
</html>
